verdict.line: You lose trades any time you fight Garen with your E (Counter Strike) on cooldown, but the lane turns once Trinity Force and a reliable E-into-stun are both online.

brief.thesis: Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) empowers his next basic attack with bonus damage and a silence, but it is still a basic attack — your E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks, so timing E to eat that attack voids the entire trade and stuns him instead. The problem is cooldowns: his Q resets every 8 seconds while your E starts at 18 seconds (down to 10s at rank 5), so Garen can simply wait you out and re-engage the moment your E is down. That cooldown gap is the entire reason this is measured as a 45.5% matchup over 5,553 games despite Jax's 49.4% overall top-lane win rate.

theirWindow.when: His Q is up and your E is down
theirWindow.what: He can silence an auto for bonus damage then weave in W (Courage) and E (Judgment) for free. Do not trade here — Leap Strike (Q) away or toward minions and let the wave absorb his spin damage.

yourWindow.when: Your E is up and his Q is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is the only clean window to initiate. Walk in, let him swing first, dodge with Counter Strike, land the stun, then dump W (Empower) and autos while he's locked down.

start.why: Highest measured win rate start (45.5% over 3,938 games) — the extra AD and auto sustain helps you punish any auto he throws out before his Q is up.

boots.why: 72% pick rate and the win-rate leader; flattens the repeated auto-attack and Judgment poke he weaves between cooldowns.

core.why: Best-performing core path (53.9% over 519 games); the proc damage and move speed is what finally lets you win extended trades.
Empower-triggered bonus health and healing lets you absorb his Judgment spin while you wait for your E to come back up.
Buys out his Demacian Justice execute threshold once his ult cooldown drops as low as 20s at rank 3.

he's ahead and you need to survive his follow-up all-in after a silence lands

runes.keystoneWhy: Scales bonus health, which stacks with Jax's own passive (bonus health from AD/AP items), and directly offsets Garen's Perseverance stall where he out-regens your poke if you can't apply pressure every wave.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate (66.3%) and win rate (45.4%) pairing. Since Garen's Perseverance heals him back up outside of fights, Ignite is what actually converts your rare E-stun window into a kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Save E for his Q
playing.detail: Hold Counter Strike until Garen commits Decisive Strike. Dodging the empowered auto denies the silence and bonus damage completely and stuns him for a free follow-up.

playing.title: Don't fight on cooldown
playing.detail: If your E is down, the trade math flips hard in his favor. Disengage with Leap Strike (Q) back to minions instead of brawling.

playing.title: Deny his passive sustain
playing.detail: Perseverance regenerates his health if he avoids damage recently. Poke with an auto or Empower right as he's about to tick to erase the heal.

playing.title: Track Judgment's cooldown
playing.detail: Judgment drops from 13s to 9s by rank 5. Once it's rank 3 or higher, expect him to spin through minion waves to poke you even without full commitment.

playing.title: Respect the silence timing
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence shuts off Empower and Counter Strike activation. Pre-activate E to intercept the attack, never react after it's already landed.

playing.title: Play wave states before level 9
playing.detail: Lane and solo-kill both favor Garen early. Prioritize matching CS and setting up jungle ganks over contesting even trades solo.

playing.title: Itemize for the mid-game spike
playing.detail: Rush Trinity Force. It's the single item that flips your trading pattern from losing to winning starting around level 11.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner spells above come from measured Jax vs. Garen games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown readings, trade timings, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis of the live ability text, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: It is difficult to block Garen’s damage even if you managed to block his Decisive Strike (Q). Block Decisive Strike (W) with Counter Strike [E], stun him, and retreat.
